2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - React Router 7 with `@shopify/shopify-app-react-router` v1 (NOT Remix)
   - Shopify Polaris v13 for all UI
   - Shopify Billing API: `billing.request()` throws a redirect Response (not returns URL); must use `lineItems` array format (not flat `amount`/`interval`)
   - `billing.request()` for embedded XHR requests throws a 401 Response with App Bridge headers that App Bridge intercepts for redirect
   - GraphQL Admin API mandate: new public apps must use GraphQL exclusively since April 2025
   - Theme embed detection via GraphQL `themes` query with `files` for `settings_data.json`
   - Block types in settings_data.json: `shopify://apps/<handle>/blocks/app_embed/<uuid>` - must match by API key (client_id) to avoid false positives from deleted apps
   - GDPR mandatory webhooks: `customers/data_request`, `customers/redact`, `shop/redact`
   - Route-level `ErrorBoundary` using `boundary.error(useRouteError())`
   - `PlanTier`: `"free" | "starter" | "pro" | "ultimate"`
   - `PlanLimits` interface with 11 feature flags + label
   - Built for Shopify requirements include: Web Vitals (LCP ≤2.5s, CLS ≤0.1, INP ≤200ms), Contextual Save Bar, s-app-nav navigation, no external pages, helpful onboarding, helpful homepage with app status, error messages in red, dismissible ads, labeled/disabled premium features

     ```typescript
       await billing.request({
         plan: plan as any,
         isTest: process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production",
         returnUrl,
       });
       return null;
     } catch (error) {
       if (error instanceof Response) throw error;
       const errorData = (error as { errorData?: Array<{ field?: string; message?: string }> }).errorData;
       const details = errorData?.map((e) => e.message).join(", ");
       const message = details || (error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error));
       if (message.includes("Custom apps cannot use the Billing API")) {
         return { error: "Billing is not available for custom apps..." };
       }
       return { error: `Failed to initiate subscription: ${message}` };
     }
     ```

     ```typescript
       themes(first: 1, roles: MAIN) {
         nodes {
           id
           name
           files(filenames: ["config/settings_data.json"], first: 1) {
             nodes {
               body {
                 ... on OnlineStoreThemeFileBodyText {
                   content
                 }
               }
             }
           }
         }
       }
     }`);
     // Parse GID: "gid://shopify/OnlineStoreTheme/123" → extract numeric ID
     const gidParts = mainTheme.id.split("/");
     const numericId = gidParts[gidParts.length - 1];
     ```

     ```toml
     uri = "/webhooks/customers/data_request"

     topics = [ "customers/redact" ]
     uri = "/webhooks/customers/redact"
     ```

     - Added `useRouteError` to react-router imports
     - Added `ErrorBoundary` function export before `headers` export
     - Files: `app._index.tsx`, `app.pricing.tsx`, `app.settings.tsx`, `app.zip-codes.tsx`, `app.delivery-rules.tsx`, `app.waitlist.tsx`, `app.widget.tsx`, `app.help.tsx`

     - `webhooks.app.scopes_update.tsx` — removed `topic` from destructuring, removed console.log

     - `webhooks.customers.data_request.tsx` — removed `topic`, `customerId`, all console.logs

   - **`app/routes/app.tsx`** — Nav menu structure (read, not modified this session)

     - Fix: Converted all 6 billing configs from `{ amount, currencyCode, interval }` to `{ lineItems: [{ amount, currencyCode, interval }] }`
